text:
deploy-bot: Finished rollout step: v2026.03.17 -> us-east-1 (canary 10%) — telemetry: p95 latency +800ms, errors 502/504 up ~8%

irene_sre: seeing p99 tail 3.2s in us-east-1, gateway 524/502 spikes. paging oncall

incidents-bot: INCIDENT CREATED #INC-2026-321 - Timeout regression detected (p95/p99 spike). Paging @oncall_jeff — priority: P1

oncall_jeff: ack, pulling traces now. Can anyone confirm if this is limited to canary? Running a quick `curl` across edges to reproduce.

sam_runtime: not limited — telemetry shows sticky sessions = 40% of requests hitting canary due to cookie affinity skew. abnormal fanout to upstream gateways.

maya_product: support is seeing an uptick in customer-reported 504s, mainly AcmeCorp and NovaApps. queue rising.

alice_support: AcmeCorp ticket #8472: "requests timing out, entire feature failing" — pasted logs and added sam_runtime

netops: starting emergency regional reroute to shift edge egress off the affected GW farm. route-shift job queued, estimate ~45s for global propagation.

oncall_jeff: action plan: 1) pause rollout, 2) rollback canary -> previous artifact, 3) route-shift away from hotspot, 4) notify customers. Initiating rollback now: `/deploy rollback v2026.03.16 --region us-east-1`

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by oncall_jeff at 5967894350. Canary traffic set to 0%. Deploy pipeline: rollback started.

sam_runtime: looking at runtime logs — saw lots of `KVCache::evict()` churn during new artifact startup. suspect cache warmup + kernel selection change causing head-of-line stalls on fanout. sharing snippet:

```
[2026-03-17T13:12:05Z] WARN gateway: upstream 10.4.1.22 -> 504 timeout after 3000ms
[2026-03-17T13:12:06Z] DEBUG runtime: KVCache::evict keys=1200 duration=142ms
[2026-03-17T13:12:06Z] DEBUG runtime: kernel_select: chosen=fast_attn_v2 fallback=matmul
```

oncall_jeff: netops — did the route-shift start?

netops: route-shift started at 5967894358, migrating existing connections off farm A -> farm B, enabling short-circuit fallback on gateway for slow upstreams. Propagation ETA ~30s.

maya_product: notifying CSMs for AcmeCorp/NovaApps with a brief statement. will paste the note here once sent.

alice_support: message sent to AcmeCorp CSM (internal) and escalated to account team. customer reported start ~13:12 UTC.

sam_runtime: toggling a mitigation flag to force quantized model variant for new requests in us-east-1 to reduce kernel pressure. Also disabling a new kernel switch introduced in v2026.03.17.

oncall_jeff: rollout paused and rollback progressing. Observability: p95 downtrend starting? please post dashboard snapshots.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete at 5967894372 for region us-east-1. Canary traffic 0%, previous artifact v2026.03.16 reinstated.

netops: route-shift completed at 5967894375. Edge egress now primarily on farm B. Checking error rates...

netops: Observability update: errors down to baseline, p95 back to ~180ms, p99 ~420ms. Gradual stabilization.

oncall_jeff: confirmed services stabilized at 5967894378. Marking incident mitigated. Creating post-incident: assign to sam_runtime + irene_sre for RCA.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED #INC-2026-321 - Mitigated. Customers impacted: AcmeCorp, NovaApps (subset). Severity: Sev2. Postmortem owners: sam_runtime, irene_sre.

sam_runtime: opening follow-up bug: runtime/kernel-selection + KV eviction interplay during cold start. tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml.

maya_product: request a customer-facing status update (short blurb) and notify sales for AcmeCorp/NovaApps.

alice_support: pushing status note to affected customers now. will attach timeline in the postmortem.

oncall_jeff: thanks all — we'll keep the rollback artifact and disable the problematic kernel switch until a tested patch lands. :white_check_mark:

incidents-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED #INC-2026-321 — Root cause suspected: kernel-selection change in new runtime artifact causing KV warmup-induced stalls on gateway fanout. Postmortem scheduled.
